body: U3 shipped as PR 196 on branch fix/merge-wires-artifacts, based on and targeting main at 840417d7. Two commits: 6707a5d8 wires the merge, c07c0ffe rewrites the census. Not merged; c4 stays open until it is.U+000AU+000ARECEIPTS. node --test test/unit/field-merge.test.ts exit 0, with merge.artifacts-survive-the-merge, merge.a-one-sided-artifact-removal-conflicts-rather-than-losing and merge.a-one-sided-risk-removal-conflicts-rather-than-losing all present and passing. npm run typecheck exit 0. npm test 792 pass, 0 fail. All eight CI checks green, gh pr checks 196 exit 0: pr-title-lint, receipts, typecheck, inspector, seeded-mutation, and test on 22.19.x, 24.x and 26.x.U+000AU+000AWHAT LANDED. artifacts is wired into mergeThreadTraced at both required sites, the resolution block and the merged object literal, so a thread's artifact list survives a sync instead of being dropped by every merge, and a one-sided tombstone raises a conflict rather than losing. Two mutations were run and read: removing only the merged-record write turned merge.artifacts-survive-the-merge red at exit 1; declaring a rule, echoing it into the helper, and wiring it nowhere turned the census red at exit 1.U+000AU+000ATWO GUARD TESTS BEYOND THE PLAN. The conditional spread's omission branch was untested, so replacing the whole conditional with an unconditional artifacts key left every test green while every thread record would gain a spurious artifacts: [] key and a manufactured commit on every sync. The two new conflict tests also read conflicts[0] without the conflicts.length === 1 assertion every sibling test in that file makes.U+000AU+000AONE HONESTY CORRECTION TO THE PLAN. Task 3 step 2 predicts all three behaviour tests fail on the parent. merge.a-one-sided-risk-removal-conflicts-rather-than-losing was already green on 840417d7, because spine.open_risks was already wired and Risk.retired was already required there; it is a regression guard, not a red-on-parent proof. I7 holds on the other three. The prediction was written against ladder parent 3d3148fe, before U2 landed.U+000AU+000APROCESS NOTE FOR THE NEXT SESSION. The U3 lead stopped three times believing backgrounded CI watchers would wake it. A task notification fires only when an agent has no live background children, so each notification was proof its watchers were already gone. SendMessage was not available in this session to resume it, so the orchestrator held the CI wait itself in one bounded background loop. Brief leads to hand back at the push and let the orchestrator own CI, or to hold CI in a single bounded wait rather than a watcher they expect to be woken by.
